title: Mechanisms of transcriptional regulation by salicylic acid receptors
title_zh: 水杨酸受体介导的转录调控机制
abstract: Salicylic acid (SA) is a key phytohormone that activates plant defence responses1-3. In Arabidopsis, NONEXPRESSOR OF PATHOGENESIS-RELATED GENES 1 (NPR1; also known as NIM1) and the functionally redundant NPR3 and NPR4 have been identified as dual SA receptors responsible for perceiving SA4-6. However, the mechanisms whereby SA binding to the NPR proteins leads to induction of defence gene expression remain unclear. Here we elucidate how SA triggers transcriptional activation through NPR1 and relieves transcriptional repression mediated by NPR3 and NPR4. We identified Mediator complex subunit 15A (MED15A) as a bridge between NPR1 and the Mediator complex governing transcription. SA induces direct interaction of NPR1 with MED15A. Structural and functional analysis showed that the binding of NPR1 to MED15A is essential for NPR1-mediated transcriptional activation. Meanwhile, SA relieves transcriptional repression mediated by NPR3 and NPR4. NIM1-interacting 1 interacts with NPR3, NPR4 and the TOPLESS co-repressor, connecting them to polycomb repressive complex 2 to mediate H3K27 trimethylation of SA-responsive genes. SA inhibits the interactions between NPR3 and NPR4 and NIM1-interacting 1, reduces H3K27 trimethylation levels and increases histone acetylation of the target genes to release NPR3- and NPR4-mediated repression. Our study offers a comprehensive view of SA-mediated defence gene activation. These findings lay a foundation for designing more effective SA analogues as agrochemicals and for engineering crop resistance by manipulating SA perception and signalling.
abstract_zh: 水杨酸（SA）是一种关键的植物激素，可诱导植物防御反应1-3。在拟南芥中，NONEXPRESSOR OF PATHOGENESIS-RELATED GENES 1（NPR1；也称NIM1）以及功能冗余的NPR3和NPR4已被确定为感知SA的双重受体4-6。然而，SA结合NPR蛋白如何导致防御基因表达激活的机制仍不清楚。本研究阐明了SA如何通过NPR1激活转录，并缓解NPR3和NPR4介导的转录抑制。我们确定了介体复合物亚基15A（MED15A）作为NPR1与调控转录的介体复合物之间的桥梁。SA诱导NPR1与MED15A的直接结合。结构和功能分析表明，NPR1与MED15A的结合对于NPR1介导的转录激活是必不可少的。同时，SA缓解NPR3和NPR4介导的转录抑制。NIM1相互作用蛋白1与NPR3、NPR4和TOPLESS共压抑蛋白结合，将它们连接到聚胺再压抑复合物2，从而介导SA响应基因的H3K27三甲基化。SA抑制NPR3和NPR4与NIM1相互作用蛋白1的相互作用，降低H3K27三甲基化水平，增加目标基因的组蛋白乙酰化，从而释放NPR3-和NPR4介导的抑制。本研究全面阐释了SA介导的防御基因激活机制。这些发现为设计更有效的SA类农药以及通过调控SA感知和信号通路来工程化作物抗性奠定了基础。
